outcome: Feedlot finishing performance (DMI, average daily gain, G:F)
cohort: 46 crossbred Angus heifers (approximately 15 months old; body weight = 362.3 ± 34.7 kg)
finding: A standing flank ovariohysterectomy procedure in beef heifers was successfully developed, allowing for collection of high-quality uterine, placental, and embryo/fetal tissues at various stages of gestation, with minimal surgical time and good post-surgical recovery.
